item.description: That the Board accept, for filing with the Board's Minutes, the Tourist Development Tax (TDT) Collections Data for the July 2026 returns received in the month of August 2026, as prepared by the Treasury Department of the Clerk and Comptroller's Office.Total collections received in August 2026 were $4,032,923 compared to $3,615,405 in August 2025. A comparison of August 2026 to August 2025 is an 11.5% increase. Year-to-date collections for FY2026 are $21,407,259 compared to $20,012,189 for FY2025. A comparison of FY2026 to FY2025 is a 7.0% increase.

item.title: Escambia · 2026-09-24 · Board of County Commissioners Meeting (Board of County Commissioners): Recommendation Concerning Changes to the Escambia County Health Department Service Fees - Marie Mott, JD, MS, RDN, CSSD, LDN, CHD Administrator
item.description: That the Board adopt and authorize the Chair to sign the Resolution authorizing certain fee changes by the State of Florida Department of Health, Escambia County Health Department, for the services provided by the Escambia County Health Department. The Escambia County Health Department periodically revises its schedule of fees for services and the new fees will go into effect upon the Board’s adoption of this resolution.

item.title: Escambia · 2026-09-24 · Board of County Commissioners Meeting (Board of County Commissioners): Recommendation Concerning Approval of a Proposed Settlement in the Case of Adrienne Anderson v. Escambia County, Case No.: 2023 CA 003071.
item.description: That the Board approve a total settlement payment in the amount of $50,000 with the entire settlement amount being tendered by the insurance carrier, to be paid and distributed to Plaintiff's counsel for Adrienne Anderson in settlement of all claims, including medical expenses, injuries, legal fees, and costs, in exchange for the execution of a Settlement Agreement and General Release. The County will be responsible for the insurance deductible in the amount of $10,000.
